incidents.title: Delayed Costs Data in the Compliance API
incidents.title_zh: Delayed Costs Data in the Compliance API
incidents.message: We have identified an issue causing delays in publishing Organization cost data through the Costs API. API and ChatGPT usage are not affected. We are working to restore normal data freshness.

incidents.title: Elevated errors affecting the Microsoft 365 connector
incidents.title_zh: the Microsoft 365 connector 错误率升高
incidents.message: We’re investigating an issue with Microsoft connectors where new connections may be broken and tools are not working as expected. We’ll share an update when we know more.
